record_scope_reconstruction: Kosovo Police’s July 31 and August 1 bulletins explicitly close Jarinje and Brnjak to passengers and vehicles because roads were barricaded. KoSSev reports reopening to people and goods August 1 after removal.

source_checks.finding: Official multilingual bulletins name only Jarinje and Brnjak and direct travellers to other crossings.
August 1 20:11 report confirms both posts reopened; barricades were removed at different times.
